_about: What the director's saved references look like, measured the way scripts/quality_probe.py measures (luma at 540x960, every frame). Source: studio/reviews/quality-diagnosis-2026-11-15.md. HQ re-measures when the Reel Concepts collection changes. Thresholds are provisional: they were set from 6 studio reels and 37 references, and apply to OUR EXPORT (before Instagram's re-encode, which lowered our noise readings by about 25-40 %).
collection: Instagram saved collection 'Reel Concepts' (30 reels), as Instagram served them
_our_exports_note: Read with the first, motion-sensitive measure; Pujo and Goddess move so much that the still-frame measure can't read most of their shots. Camera clips on still frames: 0.23 (ISO <= 100) to 0.51 (ISO > 1600).

temporal_noise.why: export noise above 0.50 served above 27 of 30 references and read as grainy (Pujo, Goddess). Measured only on frames whose motion is at most still_motion: motion reads as noise in this measure (2026-11-15 recheck)

motion.why: a shot whose median frame change is above 26 of 30 references reads as busy or jumpy; judge it on the strip

flicker_peak.why: a whole-frame brightness pulse of 2+ levels (8-bit) inside a shot is visible
